lines.text: After sixteen hours without sleep, you are legally impaired.
Your brain is performing like someone who is drunk.
Adenosine, a chemical waste product, is now flooding your neurons.
Your prefrontal cortex — the part that makes decisions — goes quiet.
Your amygdala, the panic center, becomes sixty percent more reactive.
You start seeing things that aren't there.
Micro-sleeps hit without warning — your eyes open but your brain is offline.
Immune cells drop by seventy percent.
Your body enters the same stress state as surviving an attack.
There is a disease called fatal familial insomnia.
It stops you from ever sleeping again, and kills you in eighteen months.
